text:
Sam Reynolds: @here Quick update — Hosted Edge Inference (hosted-edge.v1) is now GA! :tada: Low-latency routing, tiled streaming, and improved tool-calling are enabled for all orgs in supported regions. See rollout notes below.

Sam Reynolds: TL;DR: new endpoint `https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted-edge`; streaming supports multiplexed tool-calls; default quant profiles applied for cost/latency tradeoffs. Beta endpoint (`hosted-edge-beta`) will be deprecated in 90 days.

Sam Reynolds: Migration snippet (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted-edge/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"mosaicx-lite","input":"Summarize latest telemetry","stream":true,"tools":[{"name":"index_search","schema":{"q":"string"}}]}' \
  --no-buffer
```

Sam Reynolds: Ops notes: autoscaling pools are pre-warmed for top 20 customers; adaptive fallback will route to hosted-standard if capacity constrained. Rolling rollout done — no expected downtime.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: hosted-edge v1 rollout complete across us-west-2, eu-west-1 (success: 202 nodes). Logs: `deploy/edge/v1 — ok` :white_check_mark:

Kait Nguyen: Awesome — for customers on the free tier, do quotas change or is this only for paid Dedicated/Private users?

Sam Reynolds: Kait Nguyen good question — hosted-edge GA is available to all tiers, but free-tier QPS is limited to 2 rps by default. If you need higher QPS for testing, ping eng-sre and we can grant a temporary uplift.

Luis Ortega: Where can I see the new latency/cost dashboards? Need to add routes to partner onboarding docs.

Sam Reynolds: Luis Ortega dashboards are live under Console > Models > hosted-edge.v1. Also added a per-route token cost heatmap and sample traces. Link posted in #product-docs (will pin).

Anya Patel: Congrats team! :rocket: Can we run a 15m sync tomorrow to walk through migration checklist for existing customers?

Sam Reynolds: Yes, 10:30am PT tomorrow works for me. I'll invite the migration working group and attach the checklist.

Kait Nguyen: Thanks — can we also include a short FAQ for customers about tool-calling changes (schema differences)?

Sam Reynolds: Yup — FAQ + sample SDK snippets in the docs PR. Expect publish in ~2hrs.

Luis Ortega: Noted. I'll update partner onboarding templates after docs publish.

Anya Patel: :tada:

Sam Reynolds: Thanks everyone — big props to infra, runtime, and devex for getting this over the line. If you spot any regressions, please post in #incidents and tag @eng-oncall.
